location_address: 1125 Ala Moana Boulevard Pier A Honolulu, HI US 96814
description: Fully customizable private boat charter in Waikiki. Perfect for large group activities such as snorkeling, whale watching, sunset cruises, and watching the Waikiki fireworks offshore. Great platform to host events such as corporate outings, wedding parties, birthdays, memorial services, and much more. Our crew is passionate about the ocean and sharing the spirit of aloha with our island hospitality.
what_is_included:
- Snorkel gear (Mask, fins, swim floats)
- Bluetooth sound system
- In water life guard certified guides
- Shaded and sunny seating options
- Fresh water deck shower
- Iced down coolers
- Marine restroom "Head"
- USCG licensed captain

check_in_details:
Check in Details:
Please arrive early to Kewalo Basin Harbor Pier A, at least 15 min prior if getting dropped off or 30 min prior if parking. This leaves time for traffic delays, limited parking, and navigating the harbor. Our crew will meet you at the Pier A gate and board your group 10-15 minutes before departure.
* Harbor address refers to the whole harbor, so please type "Hawaii Ocean Charters" into Google or Apple maps for the correct area and look for Pier A
* Paid Parking available ~$2/hr but can be limited on very busy days
[View Kewalo Harbor Parking Map (1).pdf](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/0nOuSu4TjCCXjYbHR1aI)
what_to_bring:
- Towels
- Bathing suit (Please come dressed to go in the water)
- Sunscreen, Sunshirt, Glasses, Hat, Camera (Optional)
- Prescription Snorkel Mask (Can be rented from Snorkel Bob's if needed)
- Additional drinks or Food (Alcohol allowed to be enjoyed after swimming)
- Cash for merch and Gratuity

restrictions:
- Basic swimming ability is required to participate in the in-water portion of this charter.
- Snorkeling is a physically strenuous activity, and participants should be in good physical health to participate.
- Boating activities may not be suitable for those with pre-existing health conditions, neck or back problems, or pregnant women.
disclaimers: Weather and ocean conditions are outside of our control. While the partially protected south shore of Oahu is a wonderful place to operate, we are still in the open ocean. Passing light rain showers is normal weather in Hawaii. We will not operate in dangerous conditions.
